decisions.reason: The accelerator program remains less core and may still fall short of aspiration, but slack and exploratory value lead management to keep it while searching for better uses.
As a flagship with a dedicated page and strategic direction, management treats shortfalls as problems to solve and uses slack to retain it, making a drop unlikely.
Close to the established offer and a flagship, shortfalls trigger problemistic search rather than exit, and slack buffers uncertainty.
Aligned with core recycling machinery and protected by slack, it is kept while performance remains uncertain, with only a modest chance of pruning if aspirations are not met.
